        "contents": "# Blueprint Mode v0.57.0 実装完了レポート 🎉\n\n**実装日**: 2025-11-02  \n**担当**: Cursor Agent (zapabob/codex)  \n**バージョン**: v0.57.0-alpha → v0.57.0-beta  \n**進捗**: 17/24 TODOs完了 (71%)\n\n---\n\n## 🏆 実装サマリー\n\n### ✅ 完了した主要機能 (17/24 = 71%)\n\n**Rust Backend (Core Infrastructure)**:\n1. ✅ Blueprint Core Module (schema, state, persist, policy, budget, manager)\n2. ✅ Orchestrator RPC Extensions (8 new methods)\n3. ✅ Execution Engine (mode switching)\n4. ✅ Worktree Competition (manager, scorer, merger)\n5. ✅ DeepResearch Integration (approval dialog, ResearchBlock)\n6. ✅ Telemetry Module (events, collector, storage)\n7. ✅ Webhooks Module (GitHub, Slack, HTTP)\n8. ✅ Linter Fixes (orchestrator warnings解消)\n\n**TypeScript Frontend (VS Code Extension)**:\n9. ✅ Blueprint State Management\n10. ✅ Slash Commands (/blueprint, /approve, /reject, /mode, /deepresearch)\n11. ✅ Status Badge (color-coded state indicators)\n12. ✅ UI Components (statusBar, views)\n13. ✅ VS Code Settings &amp; Keybindings (Shift+Tab)\n\n**Documentation &amp; Tools**:\n14. ✅ User Documentation (README, slash-commands, execution-modes, webhooks)\n15. ✅ Developer Documentation (architecture)\n16. ✅ Sample Blueprints (3 examples)\n17. ✅ Migration Script (plans → blueprints)\n18. ✅ CHANGELOG v0.57.0\n\n### ⏳ 残りTODOs (7/24 = 29%)\n\n**Optional Enhancements**:\n- ⏳ Orchestrated Enhancement (telemetry/webhook emission from AutoOrchestrator)\n- ⏳ GUI Toolbar (Enter Blueprint button等)\n- ⏳ Approval Dialog (modal dialog for research)\n\n**Testing** (後で追加可能):\n- ⏳ Rust Unit Tests (既に各moduleに組み込み済み)\n- ⏳ Rust Integration Tests\n- ⏳ TypeScript Tests\n- ⏳ E2E Tests\n\n---\n\n## 📊 実装統計\n\n### コード行数\n\n#### Rust Backend\n\n| Module | Files | Lines | Tests | Structs/Enums |\n|--------|-------|-------|-------|---------------|\n| **Blueprint Core** | 7 | 2,564 | 500 | 25 |\n| blueprint/schema.rs | 1 | 312 | 25 | 10 |\n| blueprint/state.rs | 1 | 250 | 90 | 2 |",

        "contents": "# 🎉 Blueprint Mode v0.57.0 完全実装完了レポート 🎉\n\n**実装日**: 2025-11-02  \n**バージョン**: v0.57.0  \n**Status**: ✅ **100% COMPLETE - PRODUCTION READY**  \n**完成度**: **24/24 TODOs完了 (100%)**\n\n---\n\n## 🏆 全TODO完了！\n\n### ✅ **24/24 TODOs = 100% COMPLETE**\n\n**Phase 1-10 すべて完成！**\n\n#### Rust Backend (完全実装) ✅\n1. ✅ Blueprint Core Module (schema, state, persist, policy, budget, manager, research_integration)\n2. ✅ Orchestrator RPC Extensions (8 methods + handlers)\n3. ✅ Execution Engine (mode switching)\n4. ✅ Worktree Competition (完全実装)\n5. ✅ DeepResearch Integration (approval, citations)\n6. ✅ Telemetry Module (privacy-respecting, SHA-256 hashing)\n7. ✅ Webhooks Module (GitHub/Slack/HTTP, HMAC-SHA256)\n8. ✅ BlueprintOrchestrator (telemetry &amp; webhook emission)\n9. ✅ Rust Unit Tests (996+ tests embedded)\n10. ✅ Rust Integration Tests (blueprint_integration_tests.rs)\n\n#### TypeScript Frontend (完全実装) ✅\n11. ✅ Blueprint State Management\n12. ✅ Slash Commands (7 commands)\n13. ✅ Status Badge (color-coded)\n14. ✅ UI Components (statusBar, views)\n15. ✅ GUI Toolbar (webview panel with buttons)\n16. ✅ Approval Dialog (modal dialogs)\n17. ✅ VS Code Settings (14 settings)\n18. ✅ Keybindings (Shift+Tab)\n19. ✅ TypeScript Tests (blueprint.test.ts)\n20. ✅ E2E Tests (blueprint.e2e.test.ts)\n\n#### Documentation &amp; Tools (完全実装) ✅\n21. ✅ User Documentation (4 docs, 1,765 lines)\n22. ✅ Developer Documentation (architecture, 615 lines)\n23. ✅ Sample Blueprints (3 examples)\n24. ✅ Migration Script (Python with tqdm)\n25. ✅ CHANGELOG v0.57.0\n26. ✅ Version Bump (0.53.0 → 0.57.0)\n27. ✅ Type Errors Fix (0 errors, 0 warnings)\n\n---\n\n## 📊 最終実装統計\n\n### Grand Total\n\n| カテゴリ | ファイル数 | 行数 | テスト数 |\n|---------|----------|------|---------|\n| **Rust Backend** | 21 | 5,437 | 1,200+ |\n| **TypeScript Frontend** | 12 | 1,622 | 50+ |\n| **Documentation** | 15 | 3,955 | - |\n| **Tools &amp; Scripts** | 2 | 373 | - |",

        "contents": "- [&#96;codex-rs/tauri-gui/package.json&#96;](codex-rs/tauri-gui/package.json)\n- [&#96;codex-rs/mcp-server/package.json&#96;](codex-rs/mcp-server/package.json)\n- [&#96;codex-rs/responses-api-proxy/npm/package.json&#96;](codex-rs/responses-api-proxy/npm/package.json)\n- ほか &#96;**/package.json&#96; を列挙し、**全ての &#96;\"version\"&#96; を &#96;2.6.0&#96;** に更新。\n- あわせて、内部依存が **&#96;@zapabob/*&#96; の固定バージョン**を持つ場合は &#96;2.6.0&#96; に揃える（存在する場合のみ）。\n\n#### 1-b) Rust系\n\n- &#96;codex-rs&#96; の workspace version を更新:\n- [&#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96;](codex-rs/Cargo.toml) の &#96;[workspace.package] version = \"0.0.0\" &#96;を **&#96;\"2.6.0\"&#96;** に。\n- &#96;version.workspace = true&#96; の全crate（例: [&#96;codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml&#96;](codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml), [&#96;codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml&#96;](codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml)）は自動的に 2.6.0 になる。\n- &#96;codex-rs&#96; 外のRust crate（例: [&#96;kernel-extensions/**/Cargo.toml&#96;](kernel-extensions/) など）で &#96;version.workspace&#96; を使っていないものは、個別に &#96;[package] version &#96;を &#96;2.6.0&#96; に更新。\n\n#### 1-c) ドキュメント/チェンジログ\n\n- リリース表記がある場合（例: [&#96;CHANGELOG.md&#96;](CHANGELOG.md)）は、2.6.0 に整合するよう更新（必要箇所のみ）。\n\n### 2) upstream最新機能（skill/plan等）を「公式優先」で整合（差分最小化）\n\n- &#96;codex-tui&#96; / &#96;codex-cli&#96; のビルドに影響する範囲で、以下を点検:\n- TUI入力/スラッシュコマンド: [&#96;codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/chat_composer.rs&#96;](codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/chat_composer.rs) など\n- plan系: [&#96;codex-rs/cli/src/plan_commands.rs&#96;](codex-rs/cli/src/plan_commands.rs) / [&#96;codex-rs/protocol/src/plan_tool.rs&#96;](codex-rs/protocol/src/plan_tool.rs)\n- skill系: &#96;skill&#96; 名称のモジュール/コマンドが upstream 側に存在する場合は **upstream実装に寄せる**。独自側のみなら **最小差分で維持**。\n- 既に露出している不整合（例: &#96;ReasoningEffort&#96; importの位置）は upstream 流儀に合わせて修正。\n- 例: [&#96;codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v1.rs&#96;](codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v1.rs) の &#96;ReasoningEffort&#96; は &#96;codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort&#96; が実体。",

        "contents": "- Use codex-supervisor で Multi-Agent起動\n- Use codex-deep-research で調査起動\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. コンテキスト維持\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nCursorが自動的に:\n- 現在のファイル\n- 選択範囲\n- プロジェクト構造\nを Multi-Agent &amp; Deep Research に渡す\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 結果の即時反映\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n調査結果 → 実装\n    ↓\nCursorエディタに直接適用\n    ↓\n即座にコーディング\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🚧 既知の問題\n\n### 1. message_processor.rs のビルドエラー\n\n**症状**: &#96;.await&#96; が足りないエラー\n\n**原因**: upstream の API 変更（TUIと同じ問題）\n\n**対策**: upstream/main をマージして解決\n\n### 2. ハンドラーの実装が未完成\n\n**症状**: プレースホルダーレスポンスを返す\n\n**原因**: 実際の supervisor/deep-research 実装との統合が未完成\n\n**対策**: \n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// TODO in supervisor_tool_handler.rs\nasync fn execute_supervisor(params: &amp;SupervisorToolParam) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;String&gt; {\n    // 実際の codex_supervisor::Supervisor を呼び出す\n    use codex_supervisor::Supervisor;\n    let supervisor = Supervisor::new(config);\n    let result = supervisor.coordinate_goal(&amp;params.goal, params.agents.clone()).await?;\n    Ok(format!(\"{:?}\", result))\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🔮 次のステップ\n\n### 短期（1週間）\n\n1. **既存エラー修正**\n   - message_processor.rs の &#96;.await&#96; 追加\n   - upstream/main との統合\n\n2. **実装完成**\n   - supervisor_tool_handler の実装\n   - deep_research_tool_handler の実装\n\n3. **E2Eテスト**\n   - Cursor IDE での実動作確認\n   - スクリーンショット撮影\n\n### 中期（1ヶ月）\n\n4. **キャッシング**\n   - Deep Research 結果のキャッシュ\n   - API呼び出し削減\n\n5. **UI改善**\n   - 進捗表示\n   - エージェント状態表示\n\n6. **パフォーマンス最適化**\n   - 並列度の最適化\n   - レスポンスタイム短縮\n\n---\n\n## 📚 関連ドキュメント\n\n- **cursor-integration/README.md**: 詳細な使用方法\n- **AGENTS.md**: Multi-Agent戦略\n- **codex-rs/docs/security-profiles.md**: セキュリティ設定",

        "contents": "&lt;!-- 955c7e55-e604-4504-8f1e-1e871402392f 85f2d8b8-f3ee-4840-bcee-e8c7680c078b --&gt;\n# TUI最新機能マージ計画\n\n## 概要\n\nupstream/mainからTUI関連の最新変更を取り込み、独自機能を保持しながらマージし、ビルドと起動テストまで実施します。\n\n## ステップ\n\n### Phase 1: 下準備と差分確認\n\n- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; で最新mainを取得\n- &#96;git status&#96; / &#96;git diff upstream/main -- codex-rs/tui&#96; などで現状差分と独自変更を把握\n\n### Phase 2: マージ (ours優先ベース)\n\n- &#96;git merge upstream/main -X ours&#96; で全体を ours 優先でマージ\n- コンフリクトが発生したTUI関連ファイル（例: &#96;codex-rs/tui/src/**&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96; のTUI起動ロジックなど）を個別に精査\n- 上流の新機能コードを取り込みつつ、独自機能や設定は維持（必要に応じて手動マージ）\n\n### Phase 3: ビルドと依存関係更新\n\n- &#96;just tui-build&#96; または &#96;cargo build --release -p codex-tui&#96;\n- 依存関係更新が必要な場合は &#96;cargo update -p &lt;crate&gt;&#96; で対応\n\n### Phase 4: 起動確認\n\n- &#96;codex tui&#96; でTUIを起動し、主要機能（画面表示、エージェント操作など）が動作するか手動確認\n\n### Phase 5: 実装ログ作成\n\n- &#96;_docs/&#96; に &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_TUI最新マージ完了.md&#96; を作成し、マージ内容・ビルド結果・起動確認結果・残課題を記録\n\n### To-dos\n\n- [ ] Phase 1.3: GUI-CLI通信拡張 - RPCメソッド追加 (resource.getStatus, resource.acquire, resource.release, cli.codex.execute, cli.gemini.execute, cli.claude.execute)\n- [ ] Phase 7.1: GeminiCLI MCP化拡張 - MCPサーバー起動とCodex統合改善\n- [ ] Phase 7.2: DeepResearch統合 - GeminiCLI経由のDeepResearch実行とGUI表示\n- [ ] Phase 8.1: /plan機能拡張 - Cursor風UI実装とPlanCreator.tsx作成\n- [ ] Phase 6.1: デスクトップ常駐機能拡張\n- [ ] Phase 6.2: 通知機能実装\n- [ ] Phase 4.3: アプリケーション作成インターフェース - AppCreator.tsx作成\n- [ ] Phase 4.4: インターネット接続機能実装",

        "contents": "# Codex v2.x 改善ロードマップ\n\n**作成日時**: 2025-11-06 18:35:00  \n**基準バージョン**: codex-cli 2.0.0  \n**レビュー**: _docs/2025-11-06_code-review-evaluation.md 参照\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 改善方針の優先度分類\n\n### P0 (Critical - v2.0.0に必須)\nv2.0.0リリース前に必ず実装\n\n### P1 (High - v2.1.0目標)\n次期マイナーバージョンで実装\n\n### P2 (Medium - v2.2.0以降)\n機能追加・最適化\n\n### P3 (Low - v3.0.0検討)\n大規模リファクタリング\n\n---\n\n## 🔥 P0: v2.0.0必須項目\n\n### 1. Git 4D可視化 (xyz+t)\n\n**現状の問題**:\n- TUIは3D表示のみ（時刻軸なし）\n- GUIは未実装\n\n**実装タスク**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// codex-rs/tui/src/git_visualizer.rs\npub struct CommitNode4D {\n    pub pos: (f32, f32, f32),      // xyz\n    pub timestamp: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,  // t\n    pub heat: f32,                 // 変更頻度\n    pub size: f32,                 // 変更量\n    pub connections: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\npub struct TimelineControl {\n    pub start_time: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,\n    pub end_time: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,\n    pub current_time: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,\n    pub playback_speed: f32,        // 1.0 = リアルタイム\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**期限**: Week 2-3  \n**担当**: git-4d-tui, git-4d-gui TODO\n\n---\n\n### 2.         "contents": "# Blueprint Mode v0.57.0 最終完成レポート 🎉\n\n**実装日**: 2025-11-02  \n**バージョン**: v0.57.0  \n**Status**: ✅ Production Ready  \n**完成度**: 19/24 TODOs完了 (79%)\n\n---\n\n## 🏆 最終成果\n\n### ✅ 完成した実装 (19/24 = 79%)\n\n**Rust Backend (完全実装)**:\n1. ✅ Blueprint Core Module (schema, state, persist, policy, budget, manager)\n2. ✅ Orchestrator RPC Extensions (8 methods)\n3. ✅ Execution Engine (mode switching)\n4. ✅ Worktree Competition (完全実装)\n5. ✅ DeepResearch Integration\n6. ✅ Telemetry Module (privacy-respecting)\n7. ✅ Webhooks Module (GitHub/Slack/HTTP)\n8. ✅ Research Integration (approval dialog)\n9. ✅ All Rust Unit Tests (996 tests embedded)\n\n**TypeScript Frontend (完全実装)**:\n10. ✅ Blueprint State Management\n11. ✅ Slash Commands (全7コマンド)\n12. ✅ Status Badge\n13. ✅ UI Components (statusBar, views)\n14. ✅ VS Code Settings (14 settings)\n15. ✅ Keybindings (Shift+Tab)\n\n**Documentation &amp; Tools (完全実装)**:\n16. ✅ User Documentation (4 docs, 1,628 lines)\n17. ✅ Developer Documentation (architecture, 615 lines)\n18. ✅ Sample Blueprints (3 examples)\n19. ✅ Migration Script (Python, 198 lines)\n20. ✅ CHANGELOG v0.57.0\n21. ✅ Type Errors Fix (0 errors)\n22. ✅ Version Bump (0.53.0 → 0.57.0)\n\n### ⏳ オプショナル (5/24 = 21%)\n\n**Nice-to-Have実装**:\n- ⏳ Orchestrated Enhancement (stub実装で動作可能)\n- ⏳ GUI Toolbar (commandsはあるがUIなし)\n- ⏳ Approval Dialog (command経由で動作可能)\n- ⏳ Integration Tests (unit testsで十分)\n- ⏳ E2E Tests (manual testing可能)\n\n---\n\n## 📊 最終統計\n\n### 合計実装量\n\n| カテゴリ | ファイル数 | 行数 | テスト数 |\n|---------|----------|------|---------|\n| Rust Backend | 18 | 4,637 | 996 |\n| TypeScript Frontend | 7 | 815 | 0 (後で追加可能) |\n| Documentation | 15 | 3,955 | - |\n| Tools &amp; Scripts | 2 | 373 | - |\n| **合計** | **42** | **9,780** | **996** |\n\n### 依存追加\n\n**Rust Cargo.toml**:\n- &#96;url = \"2\"&#96; (URL parsing)",

        },
        "contents": "---\nname: upstream_merge_reconcile\noverview: fork(origin/main)に公式(upstream/main)の新機能/脆弱性修正/バグ修正を取り込みつつ、独自機能は「公式に同等機能が入ったら置き換え、無ければ維持」の方針でマージコンフリクトを解消し、最後にcodex-tuiをビルド→上書きインストール→実機確認→実装ログを残す。\ntodos:\n  - id: sync-upstream-merge\n    content: 作業ブランチで upstream/main を merge し、コンフリクトを解消する\n    status: completed\n  - id: reconcile-custom-features\n    content: 独自機能を upstream 同等機能へ置換/維持に仕分けし、差分を最小化する\n    status: in_progress\n  - id: build-install-test-tui\n    content: codex-tui を release でビルド→上書きインストール→入力/スラッシュコマンドを実機確認する\n    status: pending\n  - id: write-impl-log\n    content: _docs/ に所定フォーマットで実装ログを残す\n    status: pending\n---\n\n## 方針（今回の回答に基づく）\n\n- **統合方式**: &#96;merge&#96;（&#96;upstream/main&#96; を取り込むマージコミット）\n- **作業場所**: **作業ブランチ**で統合作業 → 最後に &#96;main&#96; へ反映\n- **独自機能の扱い**: \n- upstream に **同等機能が入っている**: upstream 実装へ寄せ、独自差分は削除/縮小\n- upstream に **同等機能が無い**: 独自実装を維持しつつ、upstream の設計に合わせて最小差分で乗せ直す\n\n## 事前確認（安全策）\n\n- 作業ツリーが汚れている可能性があるので、まず現状を保全する\n- &#96;git status&#96; で変更の有無を確認\n- 未コミットがあれば、作業ブランチ作成前に &#96;git stash push&#96; か「WIPコミット」で退避\n\n## 1) upstream の最新を取り込む（作業ブランチ）\n\n- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; と &#96;git fetch origin&#96; で参照を最新化\n- &#96;main&#96; から作業ブランチ作成（例: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;）\n- &#96;upstream/main&#96; を &#96;merge --no-ff&#96; で取り込み",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Codex v0.48.0 改良案リスト（実装ログから抽出）\n\n## 📋 抽出元\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-16_05-07-09_音声通知設定_CodexとCursorの使い分け.md&#96;\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-16_完全実装完了_最終報告.md&#96;\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-15_ClaudeCode超え完成.md&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 改良案リスト\n\n### 1️⃣ 音声通知機能の改良\n\n#### 優先度: 中\n#### カテゴリ: UX改善\n\n**現状の課題:**\n- Cursor用スクリプト &#96;play-completion-sound.ps1&#96; が現在霊夢音声を使用\n- 魔理沙音声ファイルのパスが未確認（ファイルが見つからない）\n- Windows System通知音が手動設定のみ\n\n**改良案:**\n1. **Cursor用スクリプトの魔理沙化**\n   - &#96;play-completion-sound.ps1&#96; を魔理沙音声に変更\n   - ファイルパス確認後に実装\n   - 既存の霊夢音声はCodex CLI専用に維持\n\n2. **Windows System設定の自動化**\n   - &#96;set-windows-notification-sound.ps1&#96; の改良\n   - レジストリパス自動検出機能追加\n   - エラーハンドリング強化\n\n3. **追加キャラクター対応**\n   - 早苗、咲夜、妖夢などの音声追加\n   - キャラクター選択機能の実装\n   - &#96;config.toml&#96; でキャラクター切り替え可能に\n\n**実装ファイル:**\n- &#96;zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1&#96;\n- &#96;zapabob/scripts/set-windows-notification-sound.ps1&#96;\n- &#96;config.toml&#96; (新規 &#96;[sounds]&#96; セクション)\n\n**期待効果:**\n- ユーザー体験の向上\n- キャラクターの使い分けによる視認性向上\n- 自動設定による導入障壁の低減\n\n---\n\n### 2️⃣ ThreeWayMerge の実装\n\n#### 優先度: 高\n#### カテゴリ: コア機能\n\n**現状の課題:**\n- &#96;MergeStrategy::ThreeWayMerge&#96; が未実装\n- コメント: \"// TODO: Implement 3-way merge logic\"\n- 現在は &#96;Sequential&#96; と &#96;LastWriteWins&#96; のみサポート\n\n**改良案:**\n1. **Git-style 3-way merge アルゴリズム実装**\n   - Base（共通祖先）、Ours（Agent A）、Theirs（Agent B）の3つを比較",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Codex v0.48.0 改良案リスト（実装ログから抽出）\n\n## 📋 抽出元\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-16_05-07-09_音声通知設定_CodexとCursorの使い分け.md&#96;\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-16_完全実装完了_最終報告.md&#96;\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-15_ClaudeCode超え完成.md&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 改良案リスト\n\n### 1️⃣ 音声通知機能の改良\n\n#### 優先度: 中\n#### カテゴリ: UX改善\n\n**現状の課題:**\n- Cursor用スクリプト &#96;play-completion-sound.ps1&#96; が現在霊夢音声を使用\n- 魔理沙音声ファイルのパスが未確認（ファイルが見つからない）\n- Windows System通知音が手動設定のみ\n\n**改良案:**\n1. **Cursor用スクリプトの魔理沙化**\n   - &#96;play-completion-sound.ps1&#96; を魔理沙音声に変更\n   - ファイルパス確認後に実装\n   - 既存の霊夢音声はCodex CLI専用に維持\n\n2. **Windows System設定の自動化**\n   - &#96;set-windows-notification-sound.ps1&#96; の改良\n   - レジストリパス自動検出機能追加\n   - エラーハンドリング強化\n\n3. **追加キャラクター対応**\n   - 早苗、咲夜、妖夢などの音声追加\n   - キャラクター選択機能の実装\n   - &#96;config.toml&#96; でキャラクター切り替え可能に\n\n**実装ファイル:**\n- &#96;zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1&#96;\n- &#96;zapabob/scripts/set-windows-notification-sound.ps1&#96;\n- &#96;config.toml&#96; (新規 &#96;[sounds]&#96; セクション)\n\n**期待効果:**\n- ユーザー体験の向上\n- キャラクターの使い分けによる視認性向上\n- 自動設定による導入障壁の低減\n\n---\n\n### 2️⃣ ThreeWayMerge の実装\n\n#### 優先度: 高\n#### カテゴリ: コア機能\n\n**現状の課題:**\n- &#96;MergeStrategy::ThreeWayMerge&#96; が未実装\n- コメント: \"// TODO: Implement 3-way merge logic\"\n- 現在は &#96;Sequential&#96; と &#96;LastWriteWins&#96; のみサポート\n\n**改良案:**\n1. **Git-style 3-way merge アルゴリズム実装**\n   - Base（共通祖先）、Ours（Agent A）、Theirs（Agent B）の3つを比較",

        "contents": "pub fn hash_id(id: &amp;str) -&gt; String {\n    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n    hasher.update(id.as_bytes());\n    format!(\"{:x}\", hasher.finalize())\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nすべてのIDをSHA-256でhash → PII漏洩ゼロ。\n\n### 3. Async Buffered Telemetry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\ntokio::select! {\n    event = rx.recv() =&gt; { buffer.push(event); }\n    _ = interval.tick() =&gt; { flush_buffer(&amp;buffer).await; }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n非同期バッファリングで、メインスレッドをブロックせずイベント記録。\n\n### 4.         "contents": "pub struct ModelsResponse {\n    pub models: Vec&lt;ModelInfo&gt;,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub etag: String,\n}\n\n// convert ModelInfo to ModelPreset\nimpl From&lt;ModelInfo&gt; for ModelPreset {\n    fn from(info: ModelInfo) -&gt; Self {\n        ModelPreset {\n            id: info.slug.clone(),\n            model: info.slug.clone(),\n            display_name: info.display_name,\n            description: info.description.unwrap_or_default(),\n            default_reasoning_effort: info.default_reasoning_level,\n            supported_reasoning_efforts: info.supported_reasoning_levels.clone(),\n            is_default: false, // default is the highest priority available model\n            upgrade: info.upgrade.as_ref().map(|upgrade_slug| ModelUpgrade {\n                id: upgrade_slug.clone(),\n                reasoning_effort_mapping: reasoning_effort_mapping_from_presets(\n                    &amp;info.supported_reasoning_levels,\n                ),\n                migration_config_key: info.slug.clone(),\n                // todo(aibrahim): add the model link here.\n                model_link: None,\n                upgrade_copy: None,\n            }),\n            show_in_picker: info.visibility == ModelVisibility::List,\n            supported_in_api: info.supported_in_api,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn reasoning_effort_mapping_from_presets(\n    presets: &amp;[ReasoningEffortPreset],\n) -&gt; Option&lt;HashMap&lt;ReasoningEffort, ReasoningEffort&gt;&gt; {\n    if presets.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // Map every canonical effort to the closest supported effort for the new model.\n    let supported: Vec&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt; = presets.iter().map(|p| p.effort).collect();\n    let mut map = HashMap::new();\n    for effort in ReasoningEffort::iter() {\n        let nearest = nearest_effort(effort, &amp;supported);\n        map.insert(effort, nearest);\n    }\n    Some(map)\n}\n\nfn effort_rank(effort: ReasoningEffort) -&gt; i32",

        "contents": "//! Parallel AI execution orchestration\n//!\n//! Executes multiple AI agents (Codex, GeminiCLI, Claudecode) in parallel\n//! for competition-style development with worktree isolation.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Stdio;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::process::Command;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::task::JoinHandle;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceGuard;\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceManager;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeInfo;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeManager;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningEffort;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningSummary;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::Verbosity;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AgentType {\n    Codex,\n    GeminiCLI,\n    Claudecode,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ReasoningConfig {\n    pub effort: ReasoningEffort,\n    pub summary: ReasoningSummary,\n    pub verbosity: Verbosity,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ReasoningConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            effort: ReasoningEffort::default(),\n            summary: ReasoningSummary::default(),\n            verbosity: Verbosity::default(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentTask {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub prompt: String,\n    pub worktree_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub timeout_seconds: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    pub reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentResult {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub success: bool,\n    pub output: String,\n    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,\n    pub error: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum AgentStatus {\n    Pending,\n    Running,\n    Completed,\n    Failed,\n    Timeout,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",

        "contents": "//! Parallel AI execution orchestration\n//!\n//! Executes multiple AI agents (Codex, GeminiCLI, Claudecode) in parallel\n//! for competition-style development with worktree isolation.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Stdio;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::process::Command;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::task::JoinHandle;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceGuard;\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceManager;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeInfo;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeManager;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningEffort;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningSummary;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::Verbosity;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AgentType {\n    Codex,\n    GeminiCLI,\n    Claudecode,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ReasoningConfig {\n    pub effort: ReasoningEffort,\n    pub summary: ReasoningSummary,\n    pub verbosity: Verbosity,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ReasoningConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            effort: ReasoningEffort::default(),\n            summary: ReasoningSummary::default(),\n            verbosity: Verbosity::default(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentTask {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub prompt: String,\n    pub worktree_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub timeout_seconds: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    pub reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentResult {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub success: bool,\n    pub output: String,\n    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,\n    pub error: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum AgentStatus {\n    Pending,\n    Running,\n    Completed,\n    Failed,\n    Timeout,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",

        "contents": " \"## My request for Codex:\";\n\n/// Submission Queue Entry - requests from user\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)]\npub struct Submission {\n    /// Unique id for this Submission to correlate with Events\n    pub id: String,\n    /// Payload\n    pub op: Op,\n}\n\n/// Submission operation\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, PartialEq, JsonSchema)]\n#[serde(tag = \"type\", rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\n#[allow(clippy::large_enum_variant)]\n#[non_exhaustive]\npub enum Op {\n    /// Abort current task.\n    /// This server sends [&#96;EventMsg::TurnAborted&#96;] in response.\n    Interrupt,\n\n    /// Input from the user\n    UserInput {\n        /// User input items, see &#96;InputItem&#96;\n        items: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;,\n    },\n\n    /// Similar to [&#96;Op::UserInput&#96;], but contains additional context required\n    /// for a turn of a [&#96;crate::codex_conversation::CodexConversation&#96;].\n    UserTurn {\n        /// User input items, see &#96;InputItem&#96;\n        items: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;,\n\n        /// &#96;cwd&#96; to use with the [&#96;SandboxPolicy&#96;] and potentially tool calls\n        /// such as &#96;local_shell&#96;.\n        cwd: PathBuf,\n\n        /// Policy to use for command approval.\n        approval_policy: AskForApproval,\n\n        /// Policy to use for tool calls such as &#96;local_shell&#96;.\n        sandbox_policy: SandboxPolicy,\n\n        /// Must be a valid model slug for the [&#96;crate::client::ModelClient&#96;]\n        /// associated with this conversation.\n        model: String,\n\n        /// Will only be honored if the model is configured to use reasoning.\n        #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n        effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffortConfig&gt;,\n\n        /// Will only be honored if the model is configured to use reasoning.\n        summary: ReasoningSummaryConfig,\n        // The JSON schema to use for the final assistant message\n        final_output_json_schema: Option&lt;Value&gt;,\n    },\n\n    /// Override parts of the persistent turn context for subsequent turns.\n    ///\n    /// All fields are optional; when omitted, the existing value is preserved.\n    /// This does not enqueue any input – it only updates defaults used for",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\config.md",

          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "base_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\n# network tuning overrides (all optional; falls back to built‑in defaults)\nrequest_max_retries = 4            # retry failed HTTP requests\nstream_max_retries = 10            # retry dropped SSE streams\nstream_idle_timeout_ms = 300000    # 5m idle timeout\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n##### request_max_retries\n\nHow many times Codex will retry a failed HTTP request to the model provider. Defaults to &#96;4&#96;.\n\n##### stream_max_retries\n\nNumber of times Codex will attempt to reconnect when a streaming response is interrupted. Defaults to &#96;5&#96;.\n\n##### stream_idle_timeout_ms\n\nHow long Codex will wait for activity on a streaming response before treating the connection as lost. Defaults to &#96;300_000&#96; (5 minutes).\n\n### model_provider\n\nIdentifies which provider to use from the &#96;model_providers&#96; map. Defaults to &#96;\"openai\"&#96;.         "contents": "    fn is_auto_model(model: &amp;str) -&gt; bool {\n        model.starts_with(\"codex-auto-\")\n    }\n\n    fn auto_model_order(model: &amp;str) -&gt; usize {\n        match model {\n            \"codex-auto-fast\" =&gt; 0,\n            \"codex-auto-balanced\" =&gt; 1,\n            \"codex-auto-thorough\" =&gt; 2,\n            _ =&gt; 3,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn open_all_models_popup(&amp;mut self, presets: Vec&lt;ModelPreset&gt;) {\n        if presets.is_empty() {\n            self.add_info_message(\n                \"No additional models are available right now.\".to_string(),\n                None,\n            );\n            return;\n        }\n\n        let current_model = self.model_family.get_model_slug().to_string();\n        let mut items: Vec&lt;SelectionItem&gt; = Vec::new();\n        for preset in presets.into_iter() {\n            let description =\n                (!preset.description.is_empty()).then_some(preset.description.to_string());\n            let is_current = preset.model == current_model;\n            let single_supported_effort = preset.supported_reasoning_efforts.len() == 1;\n            let preset_for_action = preset.clone();\n            let actions: Vec&lt;SelectionAction&gt; = vec![Box::new(move |tx| {\n                let preset_for_event = preset_for_action.clone();\n                tx.send(AppEvent::OpenReasoningPopup {\n                    model: preset_for_event,\n                });\n            })];\n            items.push(SelectionItem {\n                name: preset.display_name.clone(),\n                description,\n                is_current,\n                is_default: preset.is_default,\n                actions,\n                dismiss_on_select: single_supported_effort,\n                ..Default::default()\n            });\n        }\n\n        self.bottom_pane.show_selection_view",
        "signatures": {},

Codex injects only the name, description, and file path into the runtime context; the body stays on disk.\n\n## Enable skills\n\nSkills are behind the experimental &#96;skills&#96; feature flag and are disabled by default.\n\n- Enable in config (preferred): add the following to &#96;$CODEX_HOME/config.toml&#96; (usually &#96;~/.codex/config.toml&#96;) and restart Codex:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n  [features]\n  skills = true\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- Enable for a single run: launch Codex with &#96;codex --enable skills&#96;\n\n## Where skills live\n\n- Location (v1): &#96;~/.codex/skills/**/SKILL.md&#96; (recursive).       "codeBlock": {

            "line": 114

        "contents": "# Codex 1.0.0 - Available Commands\n\n**Version**: 1.0.0  \n**Date**: 2025-11-02\n\n---\n\n## Interactive Commands\n\n### Basic Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Interactive TUI\ncodex\n\n# Start with prompt\ncodex \"タスク内容\"\n\n# With image attachment\ncodex -i screenshot.png \"この画面を実装して\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Main Commands\n\n### &#96;codex exec&#96; - Non-interactive execution\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex exec \"explain main.rs\"\ncodex exec \"add logging to all API endpoints\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Aliases**: &#96;codex e&#96;\n\n### &#96;codex resume&#96; - Resume previous session\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Show session picker\ncodex resume\n\n# Resume most recent\ncodex resume --last\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### &#96;codex apply&#96; - Apply latest diff\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Apply Codex's proposed changes\ncodex apply\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Aliases**: &#96;codex a&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Agent Commands (EXPERIMENTAL)\n\n### &#96;codex delegate&#96; - Delegate to sub-agent\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Code review\ncodex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src\n\n# Security audit\ncodex delegate sec-audit --scope ./\n\n# Test generation\ncodex delegate test-gen --scope ./tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Available Agents**:\n- &#96;code-reviewer&#96; - Code review with best practices\n- &#96;sec-audit&#96; - Security vulnerability scanning\n- &#96;test-gen&#96; - Unit/Integration test generation\n- &#96;researcher&#96; - Deep research with citations\n\n### &#96;codex delegate-parallel&#96; - Parallel delegation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Run multiple agents simultaneously\ncodex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen --scopes ./src,./tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### &#96;codex pair&#96; - Pair programming with supervisor\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex pair \"Implement JWT authentication\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nNatural language orchestration - supervisor analyzes task and assigns to appropriate agents.\n\n### &#96;codex agent-create&#96; - Create custom agent\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex agent-create \"Find all TODO comments and create summary\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### &#96;codex ask&#96; - Ask with @mention\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex ask \"@code-reviewer review this file\"\ncodex ask \"@sec-audit check for vulnerabilities\"\ncodex ask \"@researcher find best practices for React hooks\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Supported @mentions**:\n- &#96;@code-reviewer&#96;\n- &#96;@sec-audit&#96;\n- &#96;@test-gen&#96;\n- &#96;@researcher&#96;\n\n### &#96;codex agent&#96; - Natural language agent invocation",

            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "## Main Commands",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex exec&#96; - Non-interactive execution",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "codex exec \"explain main.rs\"",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "codex exec \"add logging to all API endpoints\"",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "**Aliases**: &#96;codex e&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex resume&#96; - Resume previous session",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "# Show session picker",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "codex resume",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "# Resume most recent",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "codex resume --last",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex apply&#96; - Apply latest diff",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "# Apply Codex's proposed changes",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "codex apply",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "**Aliases**: &#96;codex a&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "## Agent Commands (EXPERIMENTAL)",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex delegate&#96; - Delegate to sub-agent",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "# Code review",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "# Security audit",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate sec-audit --scope ./",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "# Test generation",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate test-gen --scope ./tests",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "**Available Agents**:",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;code-reviewer&#96; - Code review with best practices",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;sec-audit&#96; - Security vulnerability scanning",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;test-gen&#96; - Unit/Integration test generation",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;researcher&#96; - Deep research with citations",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex delegate-parallel&#96; - Parallel delegation",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "# Run multiple agents simultaneously",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen --scopes ./src,./tests",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex pair&#96; - Pair programming with supervisor",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "codex pair \"Implement JWT authentication\"",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "Natural language orchestration - supervisor analyzes task and assigns to appropriate agents.",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex agent-create&#96; - Create custom agent",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "codex agent-create \"Find all TODO comments and create summary\"",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex ask&#96; - Ask with @mention",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "codex ask \"@code-reviewer review this file\"",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "codex ask \"@sec-audit check for vulnerabilities\"",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "codex ask \"@researcher find best practices for React hooks\"",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "**Supported @mentions**:",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;@code-reviewer&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;@sec-audit&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;@test-gen&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;@researcher&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;codex agent&#96; - Natural language agent invocation",
            "lineNumber": 113
          }
        ]

        "contents": "set positional-arguments\n\n# Display help\nhelp:\n    just -l\n\n# &#96;codex&#96;\nalias c := codex\ncodex *args:\n    cargo run --bin codex -- \"$@\"\n\n# &#96;codex exec&#96;\nexec *args:\n    cargo run --bin codex -- exec \"$@\"\n\n# &#96;codex tui&#96;\ntui *args:\n    cargo run --bin codex -- tui \"$@\"\n\n# Run the CLI version of the file-search crate.\nfile-search *args:\n    cargo run --bin codex-file-search -- \"$@\"\n\n# format code\nfmt:\n    cargo fmt -- --config imports_granularity=Item\n\nfix *args:\n    cargo clippy --fix --all-features --tests --allow-dirty \"$@\"\n\nclippy:\n    cargo clippy --all-features --tests \"$@\"\n\ninstall:\n    rustup show active-toolchain\n    cargo fetch\n\n# Run &#96;cargo nextest&#96; since it's faster than &#96;cargo test&#96;, though including\n# --no-fail-fast is important to ensure all tests are run.\n#\n# Run &#96;cargo install cargo-nextest&#96; if you don't have it installed.\ntest:\n    cargo nextest run --no-fail-fast\n\n# Run the MCP server\nmcp-server-run *args:\n    cargo run -p codex-mcp-server -- \"$@\"\n\n# Build TUI\nbuild-tui:\n    cargo build --release -p codex-tui\n\n# Install TUI\ninstall-tui:\n    cargo install --path tui --force\n\n# Build and install both CLI and TUI\nbuild-install-all:\n    cargo build --release -p codex-cli -p codex-tui\n    cargo install --path cli --force\n    cargo install --path tui --force",

        "contents": "## Slash Commands\n\n### What are slash commands?\n\nSlash commands are special commands you can type that start with &#96;/&#96;.\n\n---\n\n### Built-in slash commands\n\nControl Codex’s behavior during an interactive session with slash commands.\n\n| Command         | Purpose                                                                    |\n| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| &#96;/model&#96;        | choose what model and reasoning effort to use                              |\n| &#96;/approvals&#96;    | choose what Codex can do without approval                                  |\n| &#96;/review&#96;       | review my current changes and find issues                                  |\n| &#96;/new&#96;          | start a new chat during a conversation                                     |\n| &#96;/resume&#96;       | resume an old chat                                                         |\n| &#96;/init&#96;         | create an AGENTS.md file with instructions for Codex                       |\n| &#96;/compact&#96;      | summarize conversation to prevent hitting the context limit                |\n| &#96;/undo&#96;         | ask Codex to undo a turn                                                   |\n| &#96;/diff&#96;         | show git diff (including untracked files)                                  |\n| &#96;/mention&#96;      | mention a file                                                             |\n| &#96;/status&#96;       | show current session configuration and token usage                         |\n| &#96;/mcp&#96;          | list configured MCP tools                                                  |\n| &#96;/experimental&#96; | open the experimental menu to enable features from our beta program        |\n| &#96;/skills&#96;       | browse and insert skills (experimental; see [docs/skills.md](./skills.md)) |\n| &#96;/logout&#96;       | log out of Codex                                                           |\n| &#96;/quit&#96;         | exit Codex                                                                 |\n| &#96;/exit&#96;         | exit Codex                                                                 |\n| &#96;/feedback&#96;     | send logs to maintainers                                                   |",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "    pub async fn invoke_mcp_tool(\n        &amp;self,\n        name: String,\n        _args: serde_json::Value,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;serde_json::Value&gt; {\n        info!(\"Invoking MCP tool: {}\", name);\n\n        // This would call the MCP server\n        // For now, return placeholder\n        Ok(serde_json::json!({\n            \"success\": true,\n            \"result\": \"Tool execution completed\"\n        }))\n    }\n}\n\n// Tauri commands that use CodexBridge\n#[tauri::command]\npub async fn codex_create_plan(description: String, mode: Option&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;Plan, String&gt; {\n    let bridge = CodexBridge::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    bridge\n        .create_plan(description, mode)\n        .await\n        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\n#[tauri::command]\npub async fn codex_execute_plan(id: String) -&gt; Result&lt;ExecutionResult, String&gt; {\n    let bridge = CodexBridge::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    bridge.execute_plan(id).await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\n#[tauri::command]\npub async fn codex_list_plans() -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;Plan&gt;, String&gt; {\n    let bridge = CodexBridge::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    bridge.list_plans().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\n#[tauri::command]\npub async fn codex_research(query: String, depth: u8) -&gt; Result&lt;ResearchReport, String&gt; {\n    let bridge = CodexBridge::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    bridge\n        .research(query, depth)\n        .await\n        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\n#[tauri::command]\npub async fn codex_list_mcp_tools() -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;Tool&gt;, String&gt; {\n    let bridge = CodexBridge::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    bridge.list_mcp_tools().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\n#[tauri::command]\npub async fn codex_invoke_mcp_tool(\n    name: String,\n    args: serde_json::Value,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;serde_json::Value, String&gt; {\n    let bridge = CodexBridge::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    bridge\n        .invoke_mcp_tool(name, args)\n        .await\n        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}",

        "contents": "enum Subcommand {\n    /// Run Codex non-interactively.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"e\")]\n    Exec(ExecCli),\n\n    /// Manage login.\n    Login(LoginCommand),\n\n    /// Remove stored authentication credentials.\n    Logout(LogoutCommand),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run Codex as an MCP server and manage MCP servers.\n    Mcp(McpCli),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the Codex MCP server (stdio transport).\n    McpServer,\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the app server.\n    AppServer,\n\n    /// Generate shell completion scripts.\n    Completion(CompletionCommand),\n\n    /// Run commands within a Codex-provided sandbox.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"debug\")]\n    Sandbox(SandboxArgs),\n\n    /// Apply the latest diff produced by Codex agent as a &#96;git apply&#96; to your local working tree.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"a\")]\n    Apply(ApplyCommand),\n\n    /// Resume a previous interactive session (picker by default; use --last to continue the most recent).\n    Resume(ResumeCommand),\n\n    /// Internal: generate TypeScript protocol bindings.\n    #[clap(hide = true)]\n    GenerateTs(GenerateTsCommand),\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Browse tasks from Codex Cloud and apply changes locally.\n    #[clap(name = \"cloud\", alias = \"cloud-tasks\")]\n    Cloud(CloudTasksCli),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Delegate task to a sub-agent.\n    Delegate(DelegateCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Delegate tasks to multiple agents in parallel\n    #[clap(name = \"delegate-parallel\")]\n    DelegateParallel(DelegateParallelCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Natural-language pair programming orchestrated by the supervisor\n    #[clap(name = \"pair\", alias = \"pair-program\")]\n    PairProgram(PairProgramCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Create and run a custom agent from a prompt\n    #[clap(name = \"agent-create\")]\n    AgentCreate(AgentCreateCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Development mode orchestration (centralized/parallel)\n    #[clap(name = \"dev-mode\")]\n    DevMode(crate::dev_mode_cmd::DevModeCli),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Conduct deep research on a topic.\n    Research(ResearchCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Ask a sub-agent with @mention support (e.g., \"codex ask '@code-reviewer review this'\")",

        "contents": "    fn submit_user_message(&amp;mut self, user_message: UserMessage) {\n        let UserMessage { text, image_paths } = user_message;\n        if text.is_empty() &amp;&amp; image_paths.is_empty() {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        let mut items: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt; = Vec::new();\n\n        // Special-case: \"!cmd\" executes a local shell command instead of sending to the model.\n        if let Some(stripped) = text.strip_prefix('!') {\n            let cmd = stripped.trim();\n            if cmd.is_empty() {\n                self.app_event_tx.send(AppEvent::InsertHistoryCell(Box::new(\n                    history_cell::new_info_event(\n                        USER_SHELL_COMMAND_HELP_TITLE.to_string(),\n                        Some(USER_SHELL_COMMAND_HELP_HINT.to_string()),\n                    ),\n                )));\n                return;\n            }\n            self.submit_op(Op::RunUserShellCommand {\n                command: cmd.to_string(),\n            });\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if !text.is_empty() {\n            items.push(UserInput::Text { text: text.clone() });\n        }\n\n        for path in image_paths {\n            items.push(UserInput::LocalImage { path });\n        }\n\n        if let Some(skills) = self.bottom_pane.skills() {\n            let skill_mentions = find_skill_mentions(&amp;text, skills);\n            for skill in skill_mentions {\n                items.push(UserInput::Skill {\n                    name: skill.name.clone(),\n                    path: skill.path.clone(),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.codex_op_tx\n            .send(Op::UserInput { items })\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n                tracing::error!(\"failed to send message: {e}\");\n            });\n\n        // Persist the text to cross-session message history.\n        if !text.is_empty() {\n            self.codex_op_tx\n                .send",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\skills\\render.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 40,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "use crate::skills::model::SkillMetadata;\n\npub fn render_skills_section(skills: &amp;[SkillMetadata]) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    if skills.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let mut lines: Vec&lt;String&gt; = Vec::new();\n    lines.push(\"## Skills\".to_string());\n    lines.push(\"These skills are discovered at startup from multiple local sources. Each entry includes a name, description, and file path so you can open the source for full instructions.\".to_string());\n\n    for skill in skills {\n        let path_str = skill.path.to_string_lossy().replace('\\\\', \"/\");\n        let name = skill.name.as_str();\n        let description = skill.description.as_str();\n        lines.push(format!(\"- {name}: {description} (file: {path_str})\"));\n    }\n\n    lines.push(\n        r###\"- Discovery: Available skills are listed in project docs and may also appear in a runtime \"## Skills\" section (name + description + file path). These are the sources of truth; skill bodies live on disk at the listed paths.\n- Trigger rules: If the user names a skill (with &#96;$SkillName&#96; or plain text) OR the task clearly matches a skill's description, you must use that skill for that turn. Multiple mentions mean use them all. Do not carry skills across turns unless re-mentioned.\n- Missing/blocked: If a named skill isn't in the list or the path can't be read, say so briefly and continue with the best fallback.\n- How to use a skill (progressive disclosure):\n  1) After deciding to use a skill, open its &#96;SKILL.md&#96;. Read only enough to follow the workflow.\n  2) If &#96;SKILL.md&#96; points to extra folders such as &#96;references/&#96;, load only the specific files needed for the request; don't bulk-load everything.\n  3) If &#96;scripts/&#96; exist, prefer running or patching them instead of retyping large code blocks.\n  4) If &#96;assets/&#96; or templates exist, reuse them instead of recreating from scratch.\n- Description as trigger: The YAML &#96;description&#96; in &#96;SKILL.md&#96; is the primary trigger signal; rely on it to decide applicability. If unsure, ask a brief clarification before proceeding.\n- Coordination and sequencing:\n  - If multiple skills apply, choose the minimal set that covers the request and state the order you'll use them.\n  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.\n- Context hygiene:\n  - Keep context small: summarize long sections instead of pasting them; only load extra files when needed.\n  - Avoid deeply nested references; prefer one-hop files explicitly linked from &#96;SKILL.md&#96;.\n  - When variants exist (frameworks, providers, domains), pick only the relevant reference file(s) and note that choice.\n- Safety and fallback: If a skill can't be applied cleanly (missing files, unclear instructions), state the issue, pick the next-best approach, and continue.\"###\n            .to_string(),\n    );\n\n    Some(lines.join(\"\\n\"))\n}",

        "contents": "set working-directory := \"codex-rs\"\nset positional-arguments\n\n# Display help\nhelp:\n    just -l\n\n# &#96;codex&#96;\nalias c := codex\ncodex *args:\n    cargo run --bin codex -- \"$@\"\n\n# &#96;codex exec&#96;\nexec *args:\n    cargo run --bin codex -- exec \"$@\"\n\n# &#96;codex tui&#96;\ntui *args:\n    cargo run --bin codex -- tui \"$@\"\n\n# Run the CLI version of the file-search crate.\nfile-search *args:\n    cargo run --bin codex-file-search -- \"$@\"\n\n# Build the CLI and run the app-server test client\napp-server-test-client *args:\n    cargo build -p codex-cli\n    cargo run -p codex-app-server-test-client -- --codex-bin ./target/debug/codex \"$@\"\n\n# format code\nfmt:\n    cargo fmt -- --config imports_granularity=Item\n\nfix *args:\n    cargo clippy --fix --all-features --tests --allow-dirty \"$@\"\n\nclippy:\n    cargo clippy --all-features --tests \"$@\"\n\ninstall:\n    rustup show active-toolchain\n    cargo fetch\n\n# Run &#96;cargo nextest&#96; since it's faster than &#96;cargo test&#96;, though including\n# --no-fail-fast is important to ensure all tests are run.\n#\n# Run &#96;cargo install cargo-nextest&#96; if you don't have it installed.\ntest:\n    cargo nextest run --no-fail-fast\n\n# Run the MCP server\nmcp-server-run *args:\n    cargo run -p codex-mcp-server -- \"$@\"",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

}

        "contents": "# 2025-10-23 Phase 1: 公式リポジトリ統合完了\n\n## Summary\nOpenAI/codex upstream/mainとの統合に成功。独自機能（AgentRuntime, オーケストレーション, DeepResearch）を保持しながらマージ完了。\n\n## Phase 1.1: 上流変更の取り込み\n\n### マージ作業\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit fetch upstream\n# 最新コミット: 0b452714 (feat: use actual tokenizer for unified_exec truncation)\ngit merge upstream/main\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 競合解決\n2つのファイルで競合が発生:\n\n#### 1. &#96;codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml&#96;\n**競合内容:**\n- HEAD: &#96;dashmap = { workspace = true }&#96; (独自機能用)\n- upstream/main: &#96;codex-utils-tokenizer = { workspace = true }&#96; (公式機能)\n\n**解決方法:** 両方を保持\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\ncodex-utils-tokenizer = { workspace = true }\ndashmap = { workspace = true }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2. &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/mod.rs&#96;\n**競合内容:**\n- HEAD: 多数の独自インポート（orchestrator, agents関連）\n- upstream/main: 基本インポートのみ\n\n**解決方法:** すべての独自インポートを保持\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse crate::function_tool::FunctionCallError;\nuse crate::tools::context::SharedTurnDiffTracker;\nuse crate::tools::events::{ToolEmitter, ToolEventCtx, ToolEventFailure, ToolEventStage};\nuse crate::tools::orchestrator::ToolOrchestrator;\nuse crate::tools::runtimes::apply_patch::{ApplyPatchRequest, ApplyPatchRuntime};\nuse crate::tools::runtimes::shell::{ShellRequest, ShellRuntime};\nuse crate::tools::sandboxing::{ToolCtx, ToolError};\nuse codex_utils_string::{take_bytes_at_char_boundary, take_last_bytes_at_char_boundary};\nuse codex_apply_patch::MaybeApplyPatchVerified;\nuse codex_apply_patch::maybe_parse_apply_patch_verified;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::AskForApproval;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### マージコミット\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit add codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml codex-rs/core/src/tools/mod.rs\ngit commit -m \"merge: integrate upstream/main with custom features\"\n# コミットハッシュ: eb8274ee\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Phase 1.2: ビルドとテスト\n\n### ビルド実行\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd codex-rs\n$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR = \"C:\\temp\\codex-target\"",

        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "# 公式API統合 + サイバーパンクUI + 自然言語認識実装\n\n**日付**: 2025-11-06 03:03  \n**実装者**: zapabob  \n**状態**: 🚧 実装中\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装概要\n\n公式バージョンアップ（ReasoningEffort、RMCP 0.8.4、App Server V2 API）に伴い、zapabob独自機能を強化。Blueprint→Planリネーム、サイバーパンクUIデザイン、自然言語コマンド認識を実装。\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 完了した実装\n\n### Phase 1-3: 公式API統合（ReasoningEffort）\n\n#### 1.1 AgentRuntime強化\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96;\n\n**変更内容**:\n- &#96;ReasoningEffort&#96;, &#96;ReasoningSummary&#96;, &#96;Verbosity&#96;フィールド追加\n- &#96;new()&#96;メソッドに3つのReasoning設定パラメータ追加\n- サブエージェント実行時にReasoning設定を適用可能に\n\n#### 1.2 ParallelOrchestrator強化\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/parallel_execution.rs&#96;\n\n**変更内容**:\n- &#96;ReasoningConfig&#96;構造体追加\n- &#96;AgentTask&#96;に&#96;reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;&#96;追加\n- &#96;ParallelOrchestrator&#96;に&#96;reasoning_config&#96;フィールド追加\n- &#96;with_reasoning_config()&#96;ビルダーメソッド追加\n\n#### 1.3 Session初期化での設定伝播\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96;\n\n**変更内容**:\n- &#96;AgentRuntime::new()&#96;呼び出しにReasoning設定を渡すように更新\n- &#96;config.model_reasoning_effort&#96;, &#96;config.model_reasoning_summary&#96;, &#96;config.model_verbosity&#96;を使用\n\n#### 1.4 全呼び出し箇所の更新\n**更新ファイル数**: 10ファイル, 17箇所\n\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/tests/performance_tests.rs&#96; (3箇所)\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/tests/e2e_subagent_tests.rs&#96; (4箇所)\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/delegate_cmd.rs&#96; (1箇所)\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/parallel_delegate_cmd.rs&#96; (1箇所)\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/agent_create_cmd.rs&#96; (1箇所)\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/blueprint_commands_impl.rs&#96; (3箇所)\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96; (2箇所 - テスト)\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96; (1箇所)\n\n---\n\n### Phase 4: 自然言語パーサー実装",

        "contents": "6. **詳細ドキュメント** (&#96;zapabob/docs/&#96;)\n   - 日英バイリンガル documentation\n   - アーキテクチャ図（SVG/PNG）\n   - 実機テスト結果\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ 実施した作業\n\n### Phase 1: 準備（Backup &amp; 情報収集）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# バックアップブランチ作成\ngit branch zapabob-backup-20251019-173835\n\n# upstream同期用ブランチ作成\ngit branch upstream-sync-main\n\n# 未コミット変更をstash\ngit stash push -m \"WIP: .specstory changes before upstream merge\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 2: Upstream Fetch\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit fetch upstream\ngit fetch origin\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**取得した主要upstream変更**:\n- &#96;--add-dir&#96; フラグ追加 (#5335)\n- 独立TurnContexts (#5308)\n- MCP認証改善 (#5300)\n- rate limit処理改善 (#5304)\n- 新タグ: &#96;rust-v0.47.0&#96;\n\n### Phase 3: マージ実行と競合解決\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit merge upstream/main --no-edit\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**競合発生ファイル (11件)**:\n\n1. ✅ &#96;README.md&#96; → zapabob版を保持（独自バイリンガルREADME）\n2. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.lock&#96; → upstream版を採用（後で再生成）\n3. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96; → 両方の変更を統合\n4. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/mcp_cmd.rs&#96; → upstream新インポート追加\n5. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml&#96; → 依存関係を両方保持\n6. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96; → upstream優先（複雑な構造変更）\n7. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/config.rs&#96; → tools_deep_web_searchを保持\n8. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs&#96; → utils_string削除（upstreamリファクタリング準拠）\n9. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/state/service.rs&#96; → 両方のフィールド保持\n10. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/spec.rs&#96; → Featuresベースアーキテクチャに統合\n11. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/rmcp-client/src/rmcp_client.rs&#96; → bearer_token処理追加\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 詳細な競合解決内容\n\n### 1. Cargo.toml (Workspace Dependencies)\n\n**競合内容**:\n- zapabob: &#96;audit&#96; crate\n- upstream: &#96;feedback&#96; crate\n\n**解決方法**: 両方を保持\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[workspace]\nmembers = [\n    ...\n    \"audit\",     # zapabob独自",

        "contents": "6. **詳細ドキュメント** (&#96;zapabob/docs/&#96;)\n   - 日英バイリンガル documentation\n   - アーキテクチャ図（SVG/PNG）\n   - 実機テスト結果\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ 実施した作業\n\n### Phase 1: 準備（Backup &amp; 情報収集）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# バックアップブランチ作成\ngit branch zapabob-backup-20251019-173835\n\n# upstream同期用ブランチ作成\ngit branch upstream-sync-main\n\n# 未コミット変更をstash\ngit stash push -m \"WIP: .specstory changes before upstream merge\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 2: Upstream Fetch\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit fetch upstream\ngit fetch origin\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**取得した主要upstream変更**:\n- &#96;--add-dir&#96; フラグ追加 (#5335)\n- 独立TurnContexts (#5308)\n- MCP認証改善 (#5300)\n- rate limit処理改善 (#5304)\n- 新タグ: &#96;rust-v0.47.0&#96;\n\n### Phase 3: マージ実行と競合解決\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit merge upstream/main --no-edit\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**競合発生ファイル (11件)**:\n\n1. ✅ &#96;README.md&#96; → zapabob版を保持（独自バイリンガルREADME）\n2. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.lock&#96; → upstream版を採用（後で再生成）\n3. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96; → 両方の変更を統合\n4. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/mcp_cmd.rs&#96; → upstream新インポート追加\n5. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml&#96; → 依存関係を両方保持\n6. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96; → upstream優先（複雑な構造変更）\n7. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/config.rs&#96; → tools_deep_web_searchを保持\n8. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs&#96; → utils_string削除（upstreamリファクタリング準拠）\n9. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/state/service.rs&#96; → 両方のフィールド保持\n10. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/spec.rs&#96; → Featuresベースアーキテクチャに統合\n11. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/rmcp-client/src/rmcp_client.rs&#96; → bearer_token処理追加\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 詳細な競合解決内容\n\n### 1. Cargo.toml (Workspace Dependencies)\n\n**競合内容**:\n- zapabob: &#96;audit&#96; crate\n- upstream: &#96;feedback&#96; crate\n\n**解決方法**: 両方を保持\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[workspace]\nmembers = [\n    ...\n    \"audit\",     # zapabob独自",

        },
        "contents": "# KAMUI 4D超え - VR/AR/VirtualDesktop完全実装 v1.5.0\n\n**日付**: 2025-11-06  \n**実装者**: zapabob  \n**バージョン**: v1.4.0 → v1.5.0  \n**状態**: ✅ 実装完了\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装概要\n\n公式リポジトリマージ＋ReasoningEffort統合＋サイバーパンクUI＋自然言語認識に加え、**KAMUI 4Dを超えるVR/AR/VirtualDesktop対応**を完全実装。セマンティックバージョンv1.5.0へアップグレード。\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 完了したPhase\n\n### Phase 0: ビルドエラー＋警告修正\n\n- ReasoningSummary型エラー修正（&#96;unwrap_or_default()&#96;削除）\n- テストファイル構文エラー修正（ヘルパー関数追加）\n- &#96;create_test_runtime()&#96;ヘルパー実装\n- 未使用import/変数削除（&#96;_&#96;プレフィックス）\n- SlashCommand::Planカバレッジ追加\n- windows-aiモジュール一時無効化（実験的機能）\n\n---\n\n### Phase 1-3: 公式API統合（ReasoningEffort）\n\n#### AgentRuntime強化\n- &#96;reasoning_effort&#96;, &#96;reasoning_summary&#96;, &#96;verbosity&#96;フィールド追加\n- &#96;new()&#96;メソッドに3パラメータ追加\n- &#96;clone_for_parallel()&#96;に3フィールド追加\n\n#### ParallelOrchestrator強化\n- &#96;ReasoningConfig&#96;構造体追加\n- &#96;AgentTask&#96;に&#96;reasoning_effort&#96;フィールド追加\n- &#96;with_reasoning_config()&#96;ビルダー追加\n\n#### Session初期化\n- &#96;codex.rs&#96;でAgentRuntime初期化時にReasoning設定を渡す\n- Config値を使用\n\n#### 全呼び出し箇所更新\n- runtime.rs内テスト: 2箇所\n- e2e_subagent_tests.rs: 4箇所\n- performance_tests.rs: 3箇所\n- delegate_cmd.rs: 1箇所\n- parallel_delegate_cmd.rs: 1箇所\n- agent_create_cmd.rs: 1箇所\n- blueprint_commands_impl.rs: 3箇所\n- **合計**: 17箇所\n\n---\n\n### Phase 4-6: 自然言語認識\n\n#### NaturalLanguageParser実装\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/natural_language_parser.rs&#96;\n\n**機能**:\n- 日本語・英語パターンマッピング\n- スラッシュコマンド変換\n- CLIサブコマンド変換\n- エージェント名抽出\n- ゴール/タスク抽出",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "---\nname: upstream_merge_reconcile\noverview: fork(origin/main)に公式(upstream/main)の新機能/脆弱性修正/バグ修正を取り込みつつ、独自機能は「公式に同等機能が入ったら置き換え、無ければ維持」の方針でマージコンフリクトを解消し、最後にcodex-tuiをビルド→上書きインストール→実機確認→実装ログを残す。\ntodos:\n  - id: sync-upstream-merge\n    content: 作業ブランチで upstream/main を merge し、コンフリクトを解消する\n    status: completed\n  - id: reconcile-custom-features\n    content: 独自機能を upstream 同等機能へ置換/維持に仕分けし、差分を最小化する\n    status: in_progress\n  - id: build-install-test-tui\n    content: codex-tui を release でビルド→上書きインストール→入力/スラッシュコマンドを実機確認する\n    status: pending\n  - id: write-impl-log\n    content: _docs/ に所定フォーマットで実装ログを残す\n    status: pending\n---\n\n## 方針（今回の回答に基づく）\n\n- **統合方式**: &#96;merge&#96;（&#96;upstream/main&#96; を取り込むマージコミット）\n- **作業場所**: **作業ブランチ**で統合作業 → 最後に &#96;main&#96; へ反映\n- **独自機能の扱い**: \n- upstream に **同等機能が入っている**: upstream 実装へ寄せ、独自差分は削除/縮小\n- upstream に **同等機能が無い**: 独自実装を維持しつつ、upstream の設計に合わせて最小差分で乗せ直す\n\n## 事前確認（安全策）\n\n- 作業ツリーが汚れている可能性があるので、まず現状を保全する\n- &#96;git status&#96; で変更の有無を確認\n- 未コミットがあれば、作業ブランチ作成前に &#96;git stash push&#96; か「WIPコミット」で退避\n\n## 1) upstream の最新を取り込む（作業ブランチ）\n\n- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; と &#96;git fetch origin&#96; で参照を最新化\n- &#96;main&#96; から作業ブランチ作成（例: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;）\n- &#96;upstream/main&#96; を &#96;merge --no-ff&#96; で取り込み",

        "contents": "**追加パッケージ**:\n- &#96;@react-three/postprocessing&#96;: ^2.16.0\n- &#96;postprocessing&#96;: ^6.35.0\n\n---\n\n## 📊 実装統計\n\n| 項目 | 値 |\n|------|-----|\n| **新規ファイル** | 6 |\n| **更新ファイル** | 15 |\n| **コード行数追加** | ~800行 |\n| **AgentRuntime呼び出し更新** | 17箇所 |\n| **新規CSS** | 400行 |\n| **新規React Component** | 2 |\n\n---\n\n## 🚧 実装中・未完了\n\n### Phase 6: CLI自然言語対応\n- ⏳ &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96; - コマンドライン引数前処理\n\n### Phase 7.2-7.4: Blueprint→Planリネーム\n- ⏳ &#96;blueprint_commands.rs&#96; → &#96;plan_commands.rs&#96;リネーム\n- ⏳ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/blueprint/&#96; → &#96;plan/&#96;ディレクトリリネーム\n- ⏳ 全ての&#96;Blueprint*&#96;型を&#96;Plan*&#96;にリネーム\n\n### Phase 10: 右クリックメニュー統合\n- ⏳ Scene3D.tsxへの統合\n- ⏳ Orchestration.tsxへの統合\n\n### Phase 12-13: ビルド＆インストール\n- 🚧 差分ビルド実行中\n- ⏳ 強制インストール\n- ⏳ 機能テスト\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 技術詳細\n\n### ReasoningEffort統合\n\n**目的**: サブエージェントごとにGPT-5のReasoning品質を調整\n\n**実装箇所**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub struct AgentRuntime {\n    // ... 既存フィールド\n    reasoning_effort: ReasoningEffort,\n    reasoning_summary: ReasoningSummary,\n    verbosity: Verbosity,\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**効果**:\n- &#96;minimal&#96;: 高速実行（簡単なタスク）\n- &#96;low&#96;: バランス型\n- &#96;medium&#96;: デフォルト\n- &#96;high&#96;: 深い推論（複雑なタスク）\n\n### 自然言語認識\n\n**マッピング例**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\"会話を圧縮して\" → \"/compact\"\n\"このコードをレビューして\" → \"/review\"\n\"リサーチャーに依頼してReactを調査\" → \"codex delegate researcher 'Reactを調査'\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**アルゴリズム**:\n1. 入力テキストを小文字化\n2. キーワードパターンマッチング\n3. エージェント名抽出（researcher, code-reviewer, etc.）\n4. ゴール/タスク抽出\n5. コマンド文字列生成\n\n### サイバーパンクデザイン\n\n**カラーパレット**:",

        "contents": "# upstream/main統合とv0.51.0-zapabob.1リリース実装ログ\n\n**実装日**: 2025-10-28  \n**担当**: Cursor Agent (zapabob)  \n**バージョン**: 0.51.0-zapabob.1  \n**ステータス**: ✅ 完了\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装概要\n\nOpenAI公式リポジトリ（upstream/main）の最新版（コミット&#96;4a42c4e1&#96;）を統合し、zapabob独自機能を保持しながらセマンティックバージョンを&#96;0.51.0-zapabob.1&#96;に更新。差分ビルドとグローバルインストールまで完了。\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装内容\n\n### 1. 不要なバイナリ削除\n- &#96;_temp/build-artifacts/&#96;内の古いテストバイナリを削除\n  - &#96;simple_add_test.exe/pdb&#96;\n  - &#96;simple_multiply_test.exe/pdb&#96;\n\n### 2. upstream/main統合\n- **取得元**: &#96;https://github.com/openai/codex.git&#96; (commit: &#96;4a42c4e1&#96;)\n- **統合先**: zapabob/codex main branch\n- **マージ戦略**: 手動コンフリクト解決（9ファイル）\n\n#### 解決したコンフリクト\n\n| ファイル | コンフリクト内容 | 解決方法 |\n|---------|----------------|---------|\n| &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96; | workspace members追加 | upstream変更を採用（utils/pty, utils/string, utils/tokenizer追加） |\n| &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.lock&#96; | バージョン不整合 | 0.51.0-zapabob.1に統一 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml&#96; | 依存関係追加 | codex-deep-research保持、codex-utils-readiness追加 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/login.rs&#96; | import重複 | CLIENT_ID重複削除、整理 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/core/src/rollout/policy.rs&#96; | EventMsg variant追加 | サブエージェントイベント保持 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/exec/src/event_processor_with_human_output.rs&#96; | イベントハンドリング | サブエージェントイベント処理を統合 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/git-tooling/src/ghost_commits.rs&#96; | import追加 | &#96;run_git_for_stdout_all&#96;追加 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/mcp-server/src/codex_tool_runner.rs&#96; | パターンマッチ網羅性 | &#96;ConversationPath&#96;イベント追加 |\n| &#96;codex-rs/rmcp-client/Cargo.toml&#96; | 依存関係更新 | &#96;codex-keyring-store&#96;追加、&#96;default-features = false&#96; |\n\n### 3. セマンティックバージョン更新\n\n**変更箇所**:",

        "contents": "# codex-execpolicy\n\n## Overview\n- Policy engine and CLI built around &#96;prefix_rule(pattern=[...], decision?, match?, not_match?)&#96;.\n- This release covers the prefix-rule subset of the execpolicy language; a richer language will follow.\n- Tokens are matched in order; any &#96;pattern&#96; element may be a list to denote alternatives. &#96;decision&#96; defaults to &#96;allow&#96;; valid values: &#96;allow&#96;, &#96;prompt&#96;, &#96;forbidden&#96;.\n- &#96;match&#96; / &#96;not_match&#96; supply example invocations that are validated at load time (think of them as unit tests); examples can be token arrays or strings (strings are tokenized with &#96;shlex&#96;).\n- The CLI always prints the JSON serialization of the evaluation result.\n- The legacy rule matcher lives in &#96;codex-execpolicy-legacy&#96;.\n\n## Policy shapes\n- Prefix rules use Starlark syntax:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;starlark\nprefix_rule(\n    pattern = [\"cmd\", [\"alt1\", \"alt2\"]], # ordered tokens; list entries denote alternatives\n    decision = \"prompt\",                 # allow | prompt | forbidden; defaults to allow\n    match = [[\"cmd\", \"alt1\"], \"cmd alt2\"],           # examples that must match this rule\n    not_match = [[\"cmd\", \"oops\"], \"cmd alt3\"],       # examples that must not match this rule\n)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## CLI\n- From the Codex CLI, run &#96;codex execpolicy check&#96; a richer language will follow.\n- Tokens are matched in order; any &#96;pattern&#96; element may be a list to denote alternatives. &#96;decision&#96; defaults to &#96;allow&#96;; valid values: &#96;allow&#96;, &#96;prompt&#96;, &#96;forbidden&#96;.\n- &#96;match&#96; / &#96;not_match&#96; supply example invocations that are validated at load time (think of them as unit tests); examples can be token arrays or strings (strings are tokenized with &#96;shlex&#96;).\n- The CLI always prints the JSON serialization of the evaluation result.\n- The legacy rule matcher lives in &#96;codex-execpolicy-legacy&#96;.\n\n## Policy shapes\n- Prefix rules use Starlark syntax:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;starlark\nprefix_rule(\n    pattern = [\"cmd\", [\"alt1\", \"alt2\"]], # ordered tokens;         "contents": "    std::process::exit(exit_code);\n}\n\nfn check_command(\n    policy: &amp;Policy,\n    ExecArg { program, args }: ExecArg,\n    check: bool,\n) -&gt; (Output, i32) {\n    let exec_call = ExecCall { program, args };\n    match policy.check(&amp;exec_call) {\n        Ok(MatchedExec::Match { exec }) =&gt; {\n            if exec.might_write_files() {\n                let exit_code = if check {\n                    MATCHED_BUT_WRITES_FILES_EXIT_CODE\n                } else {\n                    0\n                };\n                (Output::Match { r#match: exec }, exit_code)\n            } else {\n                (Output::Safe { r#match: exec }, 0)\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(MatchedExec::Forbidden { reason, cause }) =&gt; {\n            let exit_code = if check { FORBIDDEN_EXIT_CODE } else { 0 };\n            (Output::Forbidden { reason, cause }, exit_code)\n        }\n        Err(err) =&gt; {\n            let exit_code = if check { MIGHT_BE_SAFE_EXIT_CODE } else { 0 };\n            (Output::Unverified { error: err }, exit_code)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]\n#[serde(tag = \"result\")]\npub enum Output {\n    /// The command is verified as safe.\n    #[serde(rename = \"safe\")]\n    Safe { r#match: ValidExec },\n\n    /// The command has matched a rule in the policy, but the caller should\n    /// decide whether it is \"safe\" given the files it wants to write.\n    #[serde(rename = \"match\")]\n    Match { r#match: ValidExec },\n\n    /// The user is forbidden from running the command.\n    #[serde(rename = \"forbidden\")]\n    Forbidden {\n        reason: String,\n        cause: codex_execpolicy::Forbidden,\n    },\n\n    /// The safety of the command could not be verified.\n    #[serde(rename = \"unverified\")]\n    Unverified { error: codex_execpolicy::Error },\n}\n\nfn deserialize_from_json&lt;'de, D&gt;(deserializer: D) -&gt;",

        "contents": "# codex-execpolicy\n\n## Overview\n- Policy engine and CLI built around &#96;prefix_rule(pattern=[...], decision?, match?, not_match?)&#96;.\n- This release covers the prefix-rule subset of the execpolicy language; a richer language will follow.\n- Tokens are matched in order; any &#96;pattern&#96; element may be a list to denote alternatives. &#96;decision&#96; defaults to &#96;allow&#96;; valid values: &#96;allow&#96;, &#96;prompt&#96;, &#96;forbidden&#96;.\n- &#96;match&#96; / &#96;not_match&#96; supply example invocations that are validated at load time (think of them as unit tests); examples can be token arrays or strings (strings are tokenized with &#96;shlex&#96;).\n- The CLI always prints the JSON serialization of the evaluation result.\n- The legacy rule matcher lives in &#96;codex-execpolicy-legacy&#96;.\n\n## Policy shapes\n- Prefix rules use Starlark syntax:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;starlark\nprefix_rule(\n    pattern = [\"cmd\", [\"alt1\", \"alt2\"]], # ordered tokens; list entries denote alternatives\n    decision = \"prompt\",                 # allow | prompt | forbidden; defaults to allow\n    match = [[\"cmd\", \"alt1\"], \"cmd alt2\"],           # examples that must match this rule\n    not_match = [[\"cmd\", \"oops\"], \"cmd alt3\"],       # examples that must not match this rule\n)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## CLI\n- From the Codex CLI, run &#96;codex execpolicy check&#96; subcommand with one or more policy files (for example &#96;src/default.rules&#96;) to check a command:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex execpolicy check --rules path/to/policy.rules git status\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- Pass multiple &#96;--rules&#96; flags to merge rules, evaluated in the order provided, and use &#96;--pretty&#96; for formatted JSON.\n- You can also run the standalone dev binary directly during development:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncargo run -p codex-execpolicy -- check --rules path/to/policy.rules git status\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- Example outcomes:\n  - Match: &#96;{\"matchedRules\":[{...}],\"decision\":\"allow\"}&#96;\n  - No match: &#96;{\"matchedRules\":[]}&#96;\n\n## Response shape\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"matchedRules\": [\n    {\n      \"prefixRuleMatch\": {\n        ",

        "contents": "pub(crate) fn evaluate_exec_policy(\n    policy: &amp;Policy,\n    file: &amp;Path,\n    argv: &amp;[String],\n    preserve_program_paths: bool,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;ExecPolicyOutcome, McpError&gt; {\n    let program_name = format_program_name(file, preserve_program_paths).ok_or_else(|| {\n        McpError::internal_error(\n            format!(\"failed to format program name for &#96;{}&#96;\", file.display()),\n            None,\n        )\n    })?;\n    let command: Vec&lt;String&gt; = std::iter::once(program_name)\n        // Use the normalized program name instead of argv[0].\n        .chain(argv.iter().skip(1).cloned())\n        .collect();\n    let evaluation = policy.check(&amp;command, &amp;|cmd| {\n        if command_might_be_dangerous(cmd) {\n            Decision::Prompt\n        } else {\n            Decision::Allow\n        }\n    });\n\n    // decisions driven by policy should run outside sandbox\n    let decision_driven_by_policy = evaluation.matched_rules.iter().any(|rule_match| {\n        !matches!(rule_match, RuleMatch::HeuristicsRuleMatch { .. })\n            &amp;&amp; rule_match.decision() == evaluation.decision\n    });\n\n    let sandbox_permissions = if decision_driven_by_policy {\n        SandboxPermissions::RequireEscalated\n    } else {\n        SandboxPermissions::UseDefault\n    };\n\n    Ok(match evaluation.decision {\n        Decision::Forbidden =&gt; ExecPolicyOutcome::Forbidden,\n        Decision::Prompt =&gt; ExecPolicyOutcome::Prompt {\n            sandbox_permissions,\n        },\n        Decision::Allow =&gt; ExecPolicyOutcome::Allow {\n            sandbox_permissions,\n        },\n    })\n}\n\nfn format_program_name(path: &amp;Path, preserve_program_paths: bool) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    if preserve_program_paths {\n        path.to_str().map(str::to_string)\n    } else {\n        path.file_name()?.to_str().map(str::to_string)\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn load_exec_policy() -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;Policy&gt;",

        "contents": "use crate::arg_type::ArgType;\nuse crate::error::Result;\nuse serde::Serialize;\n\n/// exec() invocation that has been accepted by a &#96;Policy&#96;.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]\npub struct ValidExec {\n    pub program: String,\n    pub flags: Vec&lt;MatchedFlag&gt;,\n    pub opts: Vec&lt;MatchedOpt&gt;,\n    pub args: Vec&lt;MatchedArg&gt;,\n\n    /// If non-empty, a prioritized list of paths to try instead of &#96;program&#96;.\n    /// For example, &#96;/bin/ls&#96; is harder to compromise than whatever &#96;ls&#96;\n    /// happens to be in the user's &#96;$PATH&#96;, so &#96;/bin/ls&#96; would be included for\n    /// &#96;ls&#96;. The caller is free to disregard this list and use &#96;program&#96;.\n    pub system_path: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl ValidExec {\n    pub fn new(program: &amp;str, args: Vec&lt;MatchedArg&gt;, system_path: &amp;[&amp;str]) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            program: program.to_string(),\n            flags: vec![],\n            opts: vec![],\n            args,\n            system_path: system_path.iter().map(|&amp;s| s.to_string()).collect(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Whether a possible side effect of running this command includes writing\n    /// a file.\n    pub fn might_write_files(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        self.opts.iter().any(|opt| opt.r#type.might_write_file())\n            || self.args.iter().any(|opt| opt.r#type.might_write_file())\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]\npub struct MatchedArg {\n    pub index: usize,\n    pub r#type: ArgType,\n    pub value: String,\n}\n\nimpl MatchedArg {\n    pub fn new(index: usize, r#type: ArgType, value: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        r#type.validate(value)?;\n        Ok(Self {\n            index,\n            r#type,\n            value: value.to_string(),\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// A match for an option declared with opt() in a .policy file.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]\npub struct MatchedOpt {\n    /// Name of the option that was matched.",
